title: Work tape count is bounded by space used
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, every Boolean input word $x$, and every time $t\in\mathbb N$, the number of work tapes of $M$ is at most the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited through step $t$ when $M$ runs on $x$ from its initial configuration.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
the run starts from $M$'s initial configuration on $x$
